steps.say: When you speak to a group, stand still and look at your listeners.
Speak clearly, and loudly enough for the person at the back to hear you.
Plan what you will say. A short beginning, middle and end work well.
steps.show: Hello. Today I will tell you about... That is why I...

steps.say: Use order words for steps and stories.
At the end, ask if anyone has a question. Listen carefully and answer politely.

check.prompt: Which is the best way to start a short talk?

options.why: This does not tell listeners what your talk is about.

options.text: Hello. Today I will tell you about my cat.

options.why: This does not start your talk.

options.text: Mumble while looking at the floor.
options.why: Nobody will hear or follow you.

hints: A good start tells listeners what the talk is about.
It is also friendly and clear.
Which answer would make you want to listen?
check.explanation: Saying hello and telling listeners your topic is a clear, friendly way to start.
